capabilities: move selected lines up or down via commands
preserve the text selection after each move
move indented child list items together with their parent
highlight the selected lines being moved
extras: Renamed from Dynalist Mover; the README warns that default hotkeys may conflict with the Outliner plugin and that a separate VS Code port exists.
problem: Obsidian's editor has no built-in way to move multiple selected lines as a block with the selection preserved, as outliner apps like Dynalist allow.

relations.evidence: bringing a Dynalist-like smooth editing experience to your Obsidian vault

summary: Editor command plugin that moves selected lines up or down while keeping the selection, optionally moving indented children with their parent.
